description: Match a role, a hiring brief or a whole job description against Aleksei’s published work. Returns his most relevant experience first, with his recorded contribution, exact excerpts and source links. Paste the vacancy text as is. Keyword retrieval: no invented qualifications and no suitability score.

lang.description: Language of the returned edition; defaults to English.

role.description: Role title, required skills, or the full text of a vacancy; English and Russian accepted.
